title: Composing and scheduling social posts
message: Compose once with per-network overrides; slots are wall clock; Queue fills the next free slot; campaigns and evergreen run themselves

scenes.headline: Composing and *scheduling.*
scenes.sub: Compose, slots, the calendar, campaigns and evergreen.
scenes.narration: Distribute is social, on a schedule you set once. This video covers composing a post, the three ways to send it, posting slots and the timezone, the calendar, campaigns, and evergreen recycling.

scenes.headline: Real limits, enforced before you *send.*
scenes.narration: Distribute, then Compose. Pick the accounts under Post to; one post fans out to every selected account. Write once. Where a network needs its own version, Customize overrides the text or the image for that network alone. Character counts run against each network's real limit, and image requirements are enforced before you send. Instagram, Pinterest and YouTube cannot take a text-only post.

callouts.label: Post to
callouts.title: One post fans out to every selected account

callouts.text: Instagram, Pinterest and YouTube need an image.

scenes.headline: Queue. Schedule. *Post now.*
scenes.narration: Three ways to send. Queue drops the post into the next free posting slot. Schedule sends it once, at a time you pick. Post now sends immediately. Draft with AI on the text box writes a first version from what the workspace knows and proposes it; nothing touches your text until you accept.

callouts.label: Schedule
callouts.title: Once, at a time you pick

scenes.headline: 09:00 stays 09:00 through *daylight saving.*
scenes.narration: Settings, then Schedule. Set the workspace timezone and the posting slots: recurring send times, a weekday and a minute. They are stored as wall clock, so nine o'clock stays nine o'clock through daylight-saving changes. Without slots, every post needs a hand-picked date, and Queue has nowhere to put anything. Slot categories let a rule pick which slot a kind of post takes; anything without a match falls back to a general slot, so nothing strands.

callouts.label: Slots
callouts.title: Weekday + minute, stored as wall clock

callouts.text: Without slots, Queue has nowhere to put anything.

callouts.label: Categories
callouts.title: Own category → general → any, so nothing strands

scenes.headline: Drag to *reschedule.*
scenes.narration: Distribute, then Calendar. The month view shows what is queued and scheduled; switch to Week for the detail. Drag a post to another day to reschedule it. The queue list below is in your posting timezone. Recently published shows what went out, with a separate status per network, and any failed network called out.

callouts.label: Per network
callouts.title: A separate status after every send

scenes.headline: Opt in. Never recycle a *recycled post.*
scenes.narration: Two dials that run on their own. Auto-generated posts come from your Topics, up to a weekly quota you choose under Settings, Automation, optionally under a named campaign with its own tracking parameter. Every outbound link is tagged. And evergreen recycling clones a post that performed into free slots after its cooldown. It is opt-in, and a recycled post is never itself recycled.

scenes.narration: Compose once, set the slots once, and let Queue do the placing. Next: approvals, Engage, and the twenty-four-hour window.
